components.name: Problem pathway
Context field
components.description: Square dark field with readable placeholder and brass caret.

narrative.overview: Dark blue-graphite fields and brass routes relate directly to the amber and charcoal faceted portrait. The page is an understandable working map rather than a starfield. Tonal planes carry structure; readable language names every destination.
keyCharacteristics: Angular, connected routes instead of ornamental orbit icons.
Warm brass selection, sea-green orientation, quiet blue structure.
Self-hosted Barlow typography with a substantial headline scale.

rules.name: The Route Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces the text label and pressed state; it never carries selection alone.

dos: Do keep every route attached to a recognizable problem.
Do preserve content and controls under reduced motion; only route tracing is removed.
Do label generated portraits and demo boundaries honestly.
donts: Don't replace the connected diagram with a row of generic service cards.
Don't use shadows, glows or glass to imply geometry the content does not need.
